result.markdown:
# Transport Maintenance Induced Traffic Drop in Sahel

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-SAH-01-B`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by matching maintenance window MW-0007, link loss alarm ALM-000454, and cascading site down alarms.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-21 01:15 to 2026-09-21 04:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-21 01:19
- **Affected:** S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-012

## Summary

Routine transport network maintenance window executed on fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B caused a temporary link loss and subsequent site outages.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on three sites in Sahel for approximately 3.5 hours before recovering fully.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-21 01:15: Anomaly ALR-0031 started with availability and traffic drops across three sites. [ALR-0031]
- 2026-09-21 01:19: Planned maintenance MW-0007 began on fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B. [MW-0007]
- 2026-09-21 01:22: Critical alarm ALM-000454 raised for LINK_LOS on LNK-SAH-01-B. [ALM-000454]
- 2026-09-21 01:23: Critical alarms ALM-000455, ALM-000456, and ALM-000457 raised for SITE_DOWN. [ALM-000455, ALM-000456, ALM-000457]
- 2026-09-21 04:43: Link alarm ALM-000454 and site alarms ALM-000456 and ALM-000457 cleared. [ALM-000454, ALM-000456, ALM-000457]
- 2026-09-21 04:44: Site down alarm ALM-000455 cleared. [ALM-000455]
- 2026-09-21 04:45: Anomaly ALR-0031 ended as KPIs recovered completely. [ALR-0031]
- 2026-09-21 04:52: Planned maintenance MW-0007 completed. [MW-0007]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, and S-SAH-012 experienced availability, active users, and traffic drops from 2026-09-21 01:15 to 04:45. [ALR-0031]
- All three affected sites depend on fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B. [T2]
- Maintenance window MW-0007 ran on fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B from 2026-09-21 01:19 to 04:52. [MW-0007]
- Critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on LNK-SAH-01-B starting at 2026-09-21 01:22. [ALM-000454]
- SITE_DOWN alarms on the three dependent sites triggered within 10 minutes of the link loss. [T3, T6]
- No node changes occurred on the affected sites or their parent transport link during the incident window. [T4]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SAH-01-B: confirmed. Maintenance window MW-0007 precisely overlapped the traffic drop and directly caused link loss and site outages. [MW-0007, ALM-000454]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were recorded on the affected sites or parent transport link during the incident window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T4: Change log confirmed zero configuration changes were made on the affected sites or parent transport link.

## Recommended actions

- Verify that notification procedures for routine transport maintenance windows accurately inform local operational teams prior to execution.
